name: sol-luna-deepseek-router
description: Sol-led routing to native Luna, isolated DeepSeek, and user-configured OpenAI-compatible API profiles, with immutable child bindings and explicit lifecycle controls.

interface.displayName: Sol 主控 · 多模型峰谷子代理
interface.shortDescription: Sol 主控按峰谷调度 Luna、DeepSeek 与可配置 API 子代理
interface.longDescription: Keeps Sol and the current conversation intact while routing new coding tasks to native Luna, an isolated native_deepseek child with its own provider and catalog, or a user-configured OpenAI-compatible API profile. API profiles are immutable and support the official DeepSeek account or manual env/file credential references. A profile may be fixed or assigned to explicit peak/valley slots; the API panel saves configuration separately from the explicit Apply action, and existing children keep their original profile. First-version API children disable Codex built-in web search. Sol and Luna retain their normal provider and live catalog. The older shared-root gateway and GPT relay remain historical compatibility only; DSH MCP tools and the read-only trace remain explicit legacy compatibility. Version 0.11.0 is a candidate: real generic API runtime installation, restart, and desktop UI acceptance remain pending.
